text: Great story, great gameplay, great visuals, great sound. Just great! Absolutely worth your time.

All the negative reviews are based on what the game "could" have been, but for 5 bucks, you get a hell of a lot game. Super fun to play with friends while you're waiting for the rest of the group to hop on! 

For the price point, I would 100% recommend the game. 

ps for all those who are spamming "Greedy Devs" in their comments and reviews, I just Don't see it. Where is the AAA studio with 3 tiers of battlepasses and micro-transactions for every mechanic in the game? Frankly I don't understand how you can feel robbed by a game that cost less than a happy meal at Mcdonalds. SMH.

You play as a blob in a Well full of Animals. O_0 Jokes aside, the game is very light in terms of storage space but so damn pretty to look at. There's different layers to the puzzles, thankfully the only ones that are connected to the achievements are the very obvious first two. If you're a puzzle maniac you'll love this game, but you won't be dissapointed if you don't want to go as schizo.

"I want to state for the record", that this games fantastic and should be played by any fan of the series and also it hasn't aged a bit.

Signing off./
A good metroidvania worth a play - on the easier side and you can see the inspirations from other similar titles.

Normal game about breeding cats and nothing else :3
Fast paced parkour combat game.I recommend it to everyone

Very cute, relatively short "Metroidvania." You only gain a few abilities, and you basically have access to the entire map from the start, but are working to make shortcuts and explore it. The main gripe with this game is, after the initial tutorial, which is very strong, the game kind of throws you to the wolves and you have to figure out what the heck you are supposed to do. The internet is your friend here. I wish the game had a tad more "in-game" direction, but otherwise is a solid, Metroid type game with DInos, if you are into that! 

8/10
Currently playing through the sequel after finishing this. It is fantastic and enjoyable with challenging moments. I recommend it to those who enjoy a classic RPG tale.

Sick old school shoot em up, artstyle is amazing, sound design is literally flawless,bosses are a total highlight with a lot of character reminded me a bit on dead rising psychos at times,awesome setting and guns. I do think the control sheme aint perfect and it would have been nice to be able to map cover and melee on buttons.

Overall probably among my favorite "newer" retro games along with SoR4

Went back to this after abandoning the game years ago. And well, I had an absolutely beautiful time finishing it. There are only a handful of games that I'd bother to actually 100% the map, this was one of them.
- movement is great and easy to grasp (I don't play platformers that much)
- levels are great with mesmerizing art direction.
- the story is great as well
Overall amazing experience. Highly recommended.
Bought this to play with friends, and it delivers well on this front. Picking blessings and other power-ups during a run is very satisfying.

A really sad downgrade from the first game. The visuals looks cool, but the further you get, the more mazelike every level is. The majority of the guns are completely useless, ammo is sparse because you'll be using only 2 or 3 guns the whole time while your useless guns are always full. It's completely unbalance, there are dozens of perks, but you're forced to only 3 the entire game so you always feel weak, even near the end of the game. For some strange reason they decided to take out a few of the great guns from the first game and replace them with completely useless ones. Just a downgrade from the first game in every way except for visuals, really sad actually considering how much potential this game has

I don’t know if I just lost my stealth mechanics or if this game’s stealth is a downgrade from the first one.
I honestly can’t tell. Either way, it’s still a pretty good sequel. Not sure why it took me years to play it.

The game just isn't that good, in my opinion. The boss fights are extremely tedious and it just comes down to trial and error to figure how to beat them. Once you do beat a boss, there is no real satisfaction to it. It is more of a relief that it's done and over. If you want to play a game that is difficult just to be difficult, then this game is for you!

Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.

The game is FINE I guess, but it's pretty disappointing compared to the first 2 games, and it's VERY obvious that it was made by a different studio that didn't understand Little Nightmares. The AI controlling the second character if you play singleplayer is also really stupid, I had to quit out so many times because it just got stuck. Oh yeah, and you need to listen to a PODCAST to know who the final boss is! That is not a joke! Only get this game if it's on a really good sale.
inconsistent controls and even less consistent mechanics
I cannot endorse a game that has a game-breaking bug. Especially one that has been present since launch and still hasn't been fixed, 1.5 year later. Cute little creatures or not.

Truly outstanding.  The polish is incredible, the gameplay is addictive, and there is always something new and innovative being introduced to do.  Easy recommend.  My only beef is the quicktime events, which can be moderately annoying until you learn them, and also the bosses.  The bosses are a major design failure for the same reason as the QTEs - you are thrown into them with no explanation of the mechanics or chance to prepare.  I hate trial-and-error, unless it's Dark Souls style where the whole game is that way.  This game's bosses are a mess of mechanics.  But everything else is incredible.
Its an amazing game that is honestly just really good

Absolutely amazing game with an incredible vibe. I can pretty much guarantee it's not like anything you've played before. So if a quirky setting/story, weird and unsettling characters, and doing inhumane things to survive the apocalypse sound right up your alley, go ahead and get it. You won't be disappointed.
really fun parrying is tricky but once you get used to it it makes the combat really interesting

It's a good murder mystery making RPG Maker game.
The graphic is basically okay
The depth and how we make the mystery is the selling point. It's really nice touch even for a 'small' game
Had to turn it off at the compiling shaders screen because it was too scary. 10/10
Playing on expert, good game, bosses are hard, gameplay is good for a souls like , story nothing amazing

Great art direction, fun combat, lots of build variety, and occasional bugs/jank animations. My only issue is how horribly designed and forgettable the final boss is. Lame moveset, constantly runs away from you, 5 billion hp. If you don't have a ton of riposte damage, have fun tickling his balls for 10 minutes. The game is an amazing and fun experience but what a shame to end a game so weakly.
Truly a masterpiece. Immaculate. Soundtrack is also a work of art itself... everything about this game is perfection. If you haven't played or finish this game yet, you need to.

Excellent, kinda like a western Hotline Miami.. However there is a gamebreaking bug up until the end where you buy a perk to unlock the ability to dual wield revolvers that makes you unable to reload and have infinite ammo no matter what you do. If you don't mind being unable to dual wield revolvers by not buying the perk or if you preffer other weapons, then i highly reccomend it.. otherwise i advice you to wait until they correct this before buying it.
I was not expecting this to become my most played game, but it is. The only negative thing I can say about this game is that it is too addictive.

Somehow worse gameplay than the original, frequent bugs with clipping, poor damage scaling, and the worst visual effects of any halo game yet. (for the time period). 

A low effort cashgrab preying on player nostalgia.

The first Planet of Lana game was wonderful in many ways but the gameplay was a bit shallow. This sequel is a continuation of the narrative with more and more diverse gameplay and a stunning step up for the animation, backdrops, and sound. Some scenes are truly breathtaking.

It's delightful to move through this world and dive deeper into the story. There are new puzzle-solving mechanics and characters to meet. Still, the gameplay is not the strongest element. Though there are some good puzzles, many are mundane. It does, however, play well enough to keep things interestingly interactive as the story and presentation take center stage.

I can't wait for the next game in the series!

The premise and the story of the game is simple.
Platforming is fun.
Puzzles are great.
Overall 7.5 out of 10.
It’s like going to a burger place, taking one bite, and realizing it’s actually a vegan restaurant.
Not a fan of the controls and combat. Should of been completely a no combat game or had really well done combat. I also was a bit bored playing it tbh, the story does seem interesting though.

Alright, this is a new favorite. If you loved all the fish variety of Dave the Diver but didn't like the thalaasaphobia triggers, this is your game. Also, the automatic idle mode makes it a really nice game to have on, just to have something in the background.
Bad combat, boring story, tedious traversal, unrewarding exploration. Game is a random collection of ideas that do not form a coherent gaming experience.

It's fine, but for the amount of resources it's using the graphics are not really great.
The bow isn't great, it doesn't have much damage and it also doesn't really make any difference if you just use guns. Also having to change graphics settings to fix some bugs is not what you really want to do for a game to work properly(there are quite a few). So i guess i would recommend it ONLY if you are bored and got it on sale.
